prompt: The discovery of the ancient manuscript was considered ______; not only did it provide a missing link in the region's history, but it also debunked several long-held myths.

options.A: redundant
options.B: pivotal
options.C: marginal
options.D: trivial
options.E: obsolete

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Pivotal' (hayati, kilit noktada, çok önemli) sıfatı, cümlenin devamındaki 'missing link' (kayıp halka) ve 'debunked myths' (mitleri çürütmek) ifadeleriyle tam bir anlam bütünlüğü kurar. Diğer şıklar 'önemsiz' veya 'gereksiz' anlamındadır.

prompt: The scientist urged caution, arguing that the current evidence is too ______ to justify sweeping claims about the new drug's safety.

options.A: inevitable
options.B: fragmentary
options.C: lucid
options.D: robust
options.E: cordial

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Fragmentary' (parça parça, eksik, yetersiz). Büyük iddiaları (sweeping claims) desteklemek için kanıtların henüz 'tamamlanmamış' olduğu vurgulanmaktadır.

prompt: The new environmental regulations are intended to ______ the process of industrial waste management, ensuring stricter adherence to safety protocols.

options.A: complicate
options.B: hinder
options.C: facilitate
options.D: streamline
options.E: stagnate

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Streamline' (modernize etmek, daha verimli hale getirmek). Sürecin iyileştirilmesi ve protokollere uyumun artırılması için 'düzene koymak' anlamı en uygundur.

prompt: The CEO's ______ lifestyle stood in stark contrast to the company’s struggling finances and the recent wave of employee layoffs.

options.A: frugal
options.B: ostentatious
options.C: modest
options.D: austere
options.E: prudent

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Ostentatious' (gösterişli, şatafatlı). Şirketin mali zorlukları ve işten çıkarmalarla zıtlık (contrast) oluşturan şey aşırı lüks yaşamdır.

prompt: Facing a sudden ______ of applicants, the HR department had to revise its initial screening process to manage the volume effectively.

options.A: scarcity
options.B: influx
options.C: dearth
options.D: void
options.E: depletion

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Influx' (akın, istila, yoğun geliş). Başvuranların yoğun bir şekilde gelmesi (volume) durumunu niteleyen en iyi kelimedir.

prompt: The diplomat was praised for his ______ handling of the crisis, which prevented a minor border dispute from escalating into a full-scale war.

options.A: clumsy
options.B: rash
options.C: adept
options.E: indifferent

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Adept' (becerikli, usta, yetenekli). Krizi başarıyla yönetip savaşı önleyen bir diplomat için kullanılan olumlu sıfattır.

prompt: Not until the implementation of the new carbon tax ______ significant progress in the reduction of industrial emissions across the continent.

options.A: there was
options.B: did there be
options.C: was there
options.D: has there been
options.E: there had been

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' yapısı cümle başında devrik (Inversion) yapı gerektirir. 'Be' fiili devrik yapıda 'was/were' olarak başa gelir. Geçmişe atıf için 'was there' doğrudur.

prompt: It is imperative that the judicial system ______ its independence from political influence to maintain public trust in the law.

options.A: upholds
options.B: uphold
options.C: upholding
options.D: to uphold
options.E: is upholding

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is imperative that' (Zorunludur ki) yapısı Subjunctive gerektirir. Bu yapıda fiil her zaman yalın (bare infinitive) kalır; 'uphold' doğrudur.

prompt: The suspect is alleged ______ confidential information to foreign agents long before the official investigation began.

options.A: to leak
options.B: to have leaked
options.C: leaking
options.D: to be leaking
options.E: having leaked

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is alleged' (iddia ediliyor) yapısından sonra eylem geçmişte bittiği için (long before) Perfect Infinitive (to have + V3) kullanılır.

prompt: Should the volatile chemicals ______ to extreme heat, a catastrophic explosion is almost inevitable.

options.A: expose
options.B: be exposed
options.C: to be exposed
options.D: exposing
options.E: have exposed

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should' ile başlayan devrik şart cümlesi (Type 1). Kimyasallar maruz 'kalacağı' (pasif) için 'be exposed' (yalın pasif) kullanılır.

prompt: Little ______ the inventors realize that their discovery ______ the entire field of quantum physics in the years to follow.

options.A: did / would revolutionize
options.B: have / will revolutionize
options.C: do / has revolutionized
options.D: had / was revolutionizing
options.E: were / had revolutionized

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little' zarfı başta devrik yapı ister (did ... realize). Geçmişten geleceğe bakış 'would' (future in the past) ile verilir.

prompt: Rarely ______ a single individual had such a profound impact on the direction of global economic policy.

options.A: we encounter
options.B: do we encounter
options.C: has
options.D: we have encountered
options.E: have we

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion). Cümlede 'had' (V3) olduğu için yardımcı fiil 'has' devrilmiştir (Rarely has a single individual had...).

prompt: By the time the new regulations ______ next month, most corporations ______ their internal compliance systems.

options.A: are implemented / will have changed
options.B: will be implemented / have changed
options.C: were implemented / had changed
options.D: are implemented / will change
options.E: implement / would have changed

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect (will have V3)' kalıbı. Gelecekte bir ana kadar tamamlanmış olacak eylemler için kullanılır.

prompt: No sooner ______ the satellite reached its orbit ______ it began transmitting high-resolution data back to Earth.

options.A: had / than
options.B: did / when
options.C: had / when
options.D: was / that
options.E: has / then

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' (yapar yapmaz) kalıbı devrik dizilim (had + S + V3) ile kullanılır.

prompt: Had the engineers ______ the bridge's structural integrity earlier, the collapse ______ successfully.

options.A: assessed / could have been prevented
options.B: assess / could be prevented
options.C: assessed / would prevent
options.D: assessing / had been prevented
options.E: assess / might prevent

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional devriği (Had + S + V3). Geçmişteki hayali sonuç pasif olduğu için 'could have been prevented' doğrudur.

prompt: The more ______ the economic data becomes, the more ______ the market is to react to even the smallest policy shifts.

options.A: volatile / likely
options.B: volatily / likelier
options.C: volatile / likelily
options.D: volatility / likelihood
options.E: volatily / likely

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' yapısında her iki taraf da sıfat (adjective) olmalıdır.

prompt: Many assume that scientific consensus emerges simply by accumulating facts. (17) ______, consensus also depends on shared standards...

options.A: Therefore
options.B: Likewise
options.C: However
options.D: Namely
options.E: Consequently

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bir önceki cümledeki genel varsayıma zıt bir durum sunulduğu için zıtlık bağlacı 'However' (Ancak) gereklidir.

prompt: ...standards: which methods count (18) ______ reliable, how uncertainty is reported, and what replication thresholds are required.

options.A: to
options.B: at
options.C: by
options.D: as
options.E: for

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Count as' (olarak kabul edilmek/sayılmak) kalıplaşmış bir phrasal verb kullanımıdır.

prompt: When standards differ across fields, findings may (19) ______ in incompatible ways.

options.A: interpret
options.B: be interpreted
options.C: interpreting
options.D: interpreted
options.E: be interpreting

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bulgular (findings) kendi kendini yorumlayamaz, yorumlanır (pasif). Modaldan sonra yalın pasif: 'may be interpreted'.

prompt: Thus, consensus is as much about common criteria (20) ______ it is about data.

options.A: as
options.B: than
options.C: that
options.D: so
options.E: but

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'As much ... as ...' (kadar) karşılaştırma yapısı kullanılmıştır.

prompt: Without these criteria, scientific progress would be (21) ______ by endless debates.

options.A: facilitated
options.B: stymied
options.C: catalyzed
options.D: bolstered
options.E: expedited

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Stymie' (engellemek, sekteye uğratmak). Tartışmalar ilerlemeyi engelleyeceği için anlamca en uygun kelimedir.

prompt: Remote work has expanded rapidly, (22) ______ flexibility and reducing commuting time.

options.A: offering
options.B: to offer
options.C: offered
options.D: having offered
options.E: being offered

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Genişlemenin bir sonucu/ek nitelemesi olarak aktif '-ing' kısaltması (offering - sunarak) kullanılmıştır.

prompt: Yet it may also blur boundaries between work and personal life, (23) ______ to burnout.

options.A: lead
options.B: leading
options.C: to lead
options.D: led
options.E: leads

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Leading to' (yol açarak). Sürecin bir sonucunu niteleyen participle kısaltmasıdır.

prompt: (24) ______ benefits are unevenly distributed, technological progress can widen inequality.

options.A: Whether
options.B: Unless
options.C: When
options.D: Despite
options.E: Until

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'When' (-dığında/-dığı zaman). Koşul ve zaman belirten, bağlama en uygun bağlaçtır.

prompt: Policymakers must ensure that regulations (25) ______ to protect vulnerable workers.

options.A: are strengthened
options.B: strengthen
options.C: strengthened
options.D: be strengthening
options.E: strengthening

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kuralların (regulations) güçlendirilmesi (edilgen) gerektiği için Present Simple Passive kullanılmıştır.

prompt: Success depends on (26) ______ accountability and innovation are balanced correctly.

options.A: how
options.B: what
options.C: which
options.D: who
options.E: why

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Dengelemenin 'nasıl' (how) yapıldığına bağlı olduğunu belirten Noun Clause bağlacıdır.

prompt: Despite the fact that the company reported a record profit this year, ______.

options.A: it has decided to hire more staff in every department
options.B: several senior executives have been forced to resign due to misconduct
options.C: stock prices are expected to reach an all-time high tomorrow
options.D: it is planning to expand its operations into the Asian market
options.E: most investors are highly satisfied with the current management

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Despite' zıtlık ister. Kâra rağmen 'yöneticilerin istifası' (olumsuz durum) anlamca tamdır.

prompt: Unless the international community takes immediate action to curb carbon emissions, ______.

options.A: many endangered species will have a chance to survive
options.B: global warming might be slowed down significantly
options.C: we will witness an irreversible loss of biodiversity
options.D: forest areas will expand more than ever before
options.E: the targets set in the Paris Agreement will be easily met

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Unless' (-mezse) olumsuz bir koşul sunar; aksiyon alınmazsa 'geri dönülemez kayıp' (olumsuz sonuç) yaşanacaktır.

prompt: No matter how hard the rescue team tried to reach the trapped hikers, ______.

options.A: the weather conditions improved just in time
options.B: they were able to save everyone safely
options.C: the thick fog made it impossible to locate them
options.D: it was a very successful mission for all involved
options.E: the hikers were found in good health

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No matter how hard' (ne kadar uğraşsalar da) zıtlık/başarısızlık beklentisi yaratır. 'Sis yüzünden bulamamak' bu yapıyı tamamlar.

prompt: While some critics argue that digital technology isolates people, ______.

options.A: it often leads to shorter attention spans among students
options.B: it clearly facilitates global communication and community building
options.C: privacy concerns are becoming more prevalent nowadays
options.D: many apps are designed to be addictive for users
options.E: social media has many negative impacts on mental health

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'While' zıtlık bağlacıdır. İzolasyon iddiasına karşı 'küresel iletişimi kolaylaştırma' (olumlu yön) zıtlığı kurar.

prompt: So complex was the structural defect in the bridge ______.

options.A: even the most experienced engineers couldn't find a solution
options.B: that it required years of intensive restoration work
options.C: when it was first inspected by the city officials
options.D: because the materials used were of very low quality
options.E: although it appeared perfectly safe from the outside

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'So + Adjective + be + S + that' kalıbı. Defekt o kadar karmaşıktı ki 'şuna yol açtı' (that) şeklinde tamamlanmalıdır.

prompt: ______ for the timely discovery of the tumor, the patient would not have had such a good chance of recovery.

options.A: If it were not
options.B: Had it not been
options.C: Unless it was
options.D: Even if it had been
options.E: Provided it was

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional (geçmişteki hayali durum) devriği: 'Had it not been for' (olmasaydı). Sonuç 'would not have had' ile uyumludur.

prompt: Only after months of intense deliberation ______ to approve the controversial land development project.

options.A: the council agreed
options.B: did the council agree
options.C: the council had agreed
options.D: has the council agreed
options.E: the council was agreed

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after' başta devrik yapı (Inversion) ister. Geçmiş zaman dizilimi 'did the council agree' şeklindedir.

prompt: The novel, whose plot is based on real historical events, ______.

options.A: is often criticized for being too predictable
options.B: has been translated into over thirty languages
options.C: who was written by a famous author in the 19th century
options.D: it provides a unique perspective on the Great Depression
options.E: which gained immense popularity shortly after its release

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Ana özne 'the novel' dır. Relative clause bittikten sonra ana cümlenin fiili (has been translated) gelmelidir. D şıkkı 'it' gereksiz özne kullanımı nedeniyle yanlıştır.

prompt: It is recommended that anyone planning to visit the tropical region ______.

options.A: takes all the necessary vaccinations before departure
options.B: take all the necessary vaccinations before departure
options.C: to take all the necessary vaccinations before departure
options.D: taking all the necessary vaccinations before departure
options.E: should have taken all the necessary vaccinations

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is recommended that' Subjunctive yapısıdır, fiil her zaman yalın (take) kalır.

prompt: Rather than spending all their budget on aggressive marketing campaigns, ______.

options.A: the company should consider investing in product development
options.B: luxury brands have increased their prices significantly recently
options.C: marketing is essential for any business to thrive in a competitive market
options.D: they bought a new office in the city center last month
options.E: the target audience prefers traditional forms of advertising

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rather than' (yerine) bir tercih/tavsiye sunar; 'reklam yerine geliştirmeye yatırım yapmalı' anlamca tutarlıdır.

prompt: Bu yaklaşım, kısa vadeli kazançlar yerine sürdürülebilir büyümeyi hedefler.

options.A: This approach aims for sustainable growth rather than short-term gains.
options.B: This approach rejects growth in every form for short-term profit.
options.C: Sustainable growth is as important as short-term gains for this approach.
options.D: This approach focuses only on short-term profit instead of sustainability.
options.E: Short-term gains are targeted by this approach rather than sustainability.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rather than' (yerine) ve 'aim for' (hedeflemek) yapıları cümlenin tam karşılığıdır.

prompt: İnternetin yaygınlaşmasıyla birlikte, bilgiye erişim hızı artsa da bilginin doğruluğunu teyit etmek zorlaşmıştır.

options.A: Confirming the accuracy of information is hard even though the internet is common.
options.B: With the widespread use of the internet, although the speed of access to information has increased, it has become harder to verify its accuracy.
options.C: The internet has increased the speed of information, but people do not verify if it is accurate.
options.D: Accessing information is faster now, but confirming its accuracy is still very difficult.
options.E: Although the internet is common, the accuracy of information is not as important as speed.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'With the widespread use' (yaygınlaşmasıyla), 'although' (-sa da) ve 'verify/confirm accuracy' (doğruluğunu teyit etmek) ifadeleri birebir örtüşmektedir.

prompt: Ekonomik krizle başa çıkabilmek için hükümet, kamu harcamalarını azaltmak ve yerel üretimi desteklemek zorundadır.

options.A: The government must reduce public spending and support local production to cope with the economic crisis.
options.B: To solve the economic crisis, the government should ignore public spending and focus on production.
options.C: Reducing public spending is the only way for the government to support local production during a crisis.
options.D: The government has reduced public spending, so it can support local production and end the crisis.
options.E: Although there is an economic crisis, the government continues to support local production.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Cope with' (başa çıkmak), 'reduce' (azaltmak), 'must' (zorunda) anahtar kelimelerdir.

prompt: Despite the heavy rain, the football match was not postponed, which surprised the fans.

options.A: Şiddetli yağmura rağmen futbol maçının ertelenmemesi taraftarları şaşırttı.
options.B: Yağmur çok şiddetli olduğu için taraftarlar maçın ertelenmesini bekliyordu.
options.C: Futbol maçı ertelenmedi çünkü taraftarlar yağmura rağmen stadyuma gelmişti.
options.D: Taraftarlar, maçın ertelenmemesine şaşırdılar ama yine de maçı izlediler.
options.E: Maçın ertelenmesi taraftarları şaşırttı çünkü yağmur o kadar da şiddetli değildi.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Despite' (rağmen), 'postpone' (erteleme), 'surprise' (şaşırtmak) kelimeleri A şıkkında tam olarak karşılanmıştır.

prompt: The new project aims to provide clean water to rural areas where people suffer from water scarcity.

options.A: Su kıtlığı çeken insanlar için kırsal bölgelerde yeni bir temiz su projesi başlatıldı.
options.B: Yeni proje, insanların su kıtlığı çektiği kırsal bölgelere temiz su sağlamayı amaçlamaktadır.
options.C: Kırsal bölgelerdeki su kıtlığı sorunu, yeni bir temiz su projesiyle çözülmeye çalışılıyor.
options.D: Bu projenin amacı, su kıtlığı olan yerlerdeki insanlara temiz su bulmayı öğretmektir.
options.E: Temiz su sağlamak amacıyla başlatılan proje, özellikle su kıtlığı olan kırsal kesimleri hedefliyor.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Aim to' (amaçlamak), 'rural areas' (kırsal bölgeler), 'water scarcity' (su kıtlığı) kavramları B şıkkında doğru dizilmiştir.

prompt: Son araştırmalar, düzenli egzersiz yapmanın sadece fiziksel sağlığı iyileştirmekle kalmayıp aynı zamanda stresi de azalttığını göstermektedir.

options.A: Regular exercise is good for physical health and it also helps to manage stress.
options.B: Recent research shows that doing regular exercise not only improves physical health but also reduces stress.
options.C: If you want to improve your physical health and reduce stress, you should do regular exercise.
options.D: Research has proven that stress can be reduced by improving physical health through exercise.
options.E: Not only stress but also physical health can be improved by doing regular exercise.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not only ... but also' (sadece ... değil aynı zamanda ...) yapısı Türkçedeki vurguyu tam olarak karşılar.

prompt: According to the passage, bees are vital because they ______.

options.A: produce large amounts of honey for export
options.B: are the main pollinators for many food crops
options.C: help to reduce the effects of climate change
options.D: are resistant to the harmful effects of pesticides
options.E: live in diverse habitats across the globe

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: Arılar tozlaşma (pollination) için kritiktir). Metinde 'primary pollinators' ifadesi geçtiği için B doğrudur.

prompt: The author implies that the decline in bee populations ______.

options.A: is a natural process that occurs every few centuries
options.B: will have little impact on the global economy
options.C: could lead to a major crisis in the global food supply
options.D: can be easily reversed by moving colonies to urban areas
options.E: is primarily caused by the overproduction of fruits

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metinde tozlaşma olmazsa gıda arzının (food supply) riske gireceği belirtilmiştir.

prompt: In the passage, 'efficiency' is described as ______.

options.A: a purely technical and objective measurement
options.B: a neutral goal that everyone agrees upon
options.C: a value-laden concept inseparable from fairness
options.D: a term only used in mathematical economic models
options.E: the only priority for modern policymakers

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: Verimlilik adalet tartışmalarından ayrılamaz). Metin verimliliğin 'fairness' (adalet) ile olan bağını vurgular.

prompt: The author suggests that a policy may appear efficient ______.

options.A: if it benefits all social groups equally
options.B: when it shifts the burden from one group to another
options.C: only if it requires no financial investment
options.D: because it eliminates the need for any measurement
options.E: whenever it is implemented by a neutral authority

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metinde verimliliğin bir kesim üzerindeki yükü (burden) diğerine aktarabileceği söylenmiştir.

prompt: The main idea of the passage is that ______.

options.A: data is the only factor in scientific consensus
options.B: consensus is as much about shared criteria as it is about data
options.C: scientists should ignore uncertainty to reach agreement
options.D: replication is unnecessary in modern scientific research
options.E: all scientific methods are equally valid regardless of the field

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: Bilimsel fikir birliği ortak kriterlere dayanır). Veri ve ortak kriterlerin (shared criteria) önemi anlatılmaktadır.

prompt: According to the passage, incompatible findings often result from ______.

options.A: a lack of funding for research laboratories
options.B: differences in standards and methods across fields
options.C: the natural variation in physical data sets
options.D: a lack of communication between scientists
options.E: the use of overly advanced technology in trials

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Farklı alanlardaki standart ve yöntem farklarının (differences in standards) uyumsuz bulgulara yol açtığı metinde belirtilmiştir.

prompt: Remote work is described in the passage as a system that ______.

options.A: guarantees higher productivity for all employees
options.B: blurs the boundaries between professional and private life
options.C: is only beneficial for people living in urban areas
options.D: requires more supervision than traditional office work
options.E: has been rejected by most large corporations

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: Uzaktan çalışma tükenmişliğe yol açabilir). İş ve özel yaşam sınırlarını bulandırdığı (blur boundaries) belirtilmiştir.

prompt: The author implies that the transition to renewable energy ______.

options.A: is a choice rather than a necessity
options.B: will be impossible due to the high initial costs
options.C: is essential for the planet's long-term survival
options.D: depends only on the availability of solar power
options.E: should be postponed until the economy stabilizes

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: Yenilenebilir enerji bir zorunluluktur). 'Survival of the planet' ifadesi C şıkkını destekler.

prompt: According to the passage, traditional energy sources are ______.

options.A: cleaner than solar and wind energy
options.B: inexhaustible and easy to manage
options.C: the primary drivers of global warming
options.D: more cost-effective in the long run
options.E: favored by all environmental scientists

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Fosil yakıtların küresel ısınmanın ana tetikleyicisi (primary drivers) olduğu metinde geçer.

prompt: The passage points out that fossil fuels are ______.

options.A: limited and damaging to the environment
options.B: essential for reducing carbon emissions
options.C: the only way to maintain modern lifestyles
options.D: renewable if managed correctly over time
options.E: cheaper to install than wind turbines

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Finite' (sınırlı) ve 'damaging' (zarar verici) kelimeleri fosil yakıtları tarif eder.

prompt: It can be inferred from the passage that AI ______.

options.A: will eliminate all human jobs within a decade
options.B: primarily automates repetitive and routine tasks
options.C: is only useful for large-scale data analysis
options.D: cannot replace human creativity in any way
options.E: has reduced productivity in most industries

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: YZ iş gücünü dönüştürüyor). YZ'nin genelde rutin görevleri (repetitive tasks) otomatize ettiği bilgisi yaygındır.

prompt: The author suggests that workers must ______ to adapt to AI.

options.A: reject all forms of automation immediately
options.B: acquire new skills to remain competitive
options.C: focus only on traditional manufacturing jobs
options.D: expect the government to provide for all their needs
options.E: ignore technological shifts as much as possible

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metinde yeni beceriler edinmenin (acquire new skills) önemi vurgulanmıştır.

prompt: The transition to an AI-driven economy requires ______.

options.A: no planning as the market will adjust itself
options.B: careful strategic planning and policy shifts
options.C: the total elimination of the traditional workforce
options.D: ignoring the social impacts for the sake of profit
options.E: only the financial investment of large tech firms

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Careful planning' (dikkatli planlama) ihtiyacı metnin genel sonucudur.

prompt: The passage mainly discusses ______.

options.A: the history of ancient Egyptian manuscripts
options.B: how scientific findings are interpreted across fields
options.C: the impact of digital misinformation on democracy
options.D: the relationship between efficiency and fairness in policy
options.E: the role of bees in global food security

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: Yanlış bilgi demokrasiyi tehdit eder). 'Misinformation' ve 'democracy' ana temadır.

prompt: Misinformation is described as a threat because it ______.

options.A: is expensive to produce and distribute
options.B: only affects people in developing nations
options.C: undermines the foundations of democratic discourse
options.D: can be easily detected by most social media users
options.E: requires advanced technology to spread effectively

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metin yanlış bilginin demokratik söylemi baltaladığını (undermine discourse) belirtir.

prompt: The author argues that democratic discourse ______.

options.A: is immune to the effects of digital media
options.B: depends on the accuracy of shared information
options.C: should be restricted to expert panels only
options.D: can only survive if all news is censored
options.E: is no longer relevant in the modern era

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Demokrasinin bilgi doğruluğuna (accuracy) dayandığı vurgulanmaktadır.

prompt: The passage suggests that to combat misinformation, we must ______.

options.A: limit the use of all social media platforms
options.B: promote digital literacy and verification standards
options.C: rely only on information from government agencies
options.D: ignore small errors and focus on large scale lies
options.E: allow all opinions to be shared without any oversight

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Dijital okuryazarlık (digital literacy) çözüm olarak sunulur.

prompt: The tone of the author regarding misinformation is ______.

options.A: indifferent
options.B: alarmed
options.C: optimistic
options.D: cynical
options.E: ambivalent

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Yazarın üslubu, demokrasiye tehdit olarak gördüğü için endişeli/uyarıcı (alarmed) niteliktedir.

prompt: One reason for the increase in income disparity is ______.

options.A: the equal distribution of technological benefits
options.B: the lack of skilled labor in most urban centers
options.C: the way tax policies favor high-income groups
options.D: the decline in the number of small businesses
options.E: the global decrease in the demand for skilled workers

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Metin özeti: Gelir adaletsizliği artıyor). Vergi politikalarının (tax policies) zenginleri kayırması metindeki bir sebeptir.

prompt: The author suggests that income disparity ______.

options.A: has no significant impact on social stability
options.B: is a necessary part of a thriving economy
options.C: can lead to widespread social unrest
options.D: will decrease automatically as technology advances
options.E: is only a problem in developed countries

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Gelir uçurumunun toplumsal huzursuzluğa (social unrest) yol açtığı genel bir tespittir.

prompt:
Sarah: Have you noticed how many startups are failing lately?
Mark: Yes, it seems the initial hype isn't enough to sustain them.
Sarah: ______.
Mark: Exactly. A realistic budget is often missing in their plans.

options.A: Many of them have great ideas, though
options.B: Innovation is the key to their long-term success
options.C: They often underestimate the importance of stable funding
options.D: The founders are usually quite experienced
options.E: Marketing is where they spend most of their money

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Mark'ın 'bütçe eksikliği' yorumuna Sarah 'fonlama/finansal destek' (stable funding) üzerinden destek vermelidir.

prompt:
Teacher: Why is peer review so important in science?
Student: It ensures that the research is evaluated by experts before publication.
Teacher: ______.
Student: That's true, it acts as a filter for errors and biases.

options.A: So, any scientist can publish their findings immediately
options.B: Does it also help in getting more funding for the project?
options.C: It basically prevents flawed data from being accepted as fact
options.D: Many researchers find the process too time-consuming
options.E: The number of reviewers depends on the field of study

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Öğretmen, öğrencinin cevabını pekiştirmeli; 'hatalı verinin kabulünü önleme' (prevent flawed data) en mantıklı devamdır.

prompt:
Jane: I'm finding it hard to separate work from my personal life while working remotely.
Tom: I had the same issue until I created a dedicated workspace.
Jane: ______.
Tom: It really does. It tells your brain that the workday is officially over.

options.A: I don't think I have enough space in my apartment
options.B: Do you think that actually makes a difference in your focus?
options.C: My coworkers often call me after office hours anyway
options.D: I prefer working from the couch as it is more comfortable
options.E: Maybe having a physical boundary is what I need

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Jane'in 'fiziksel sınır' (physical boundary) fikri, Tom'un 'beyne iş bitti sinyali gönderme' açıklamasıyla tam uyumludur.

prompt:
Officer: Can you describe the person you saw leaving the building?
Witness: It was dark, so I only saw a tall figure in a dark coat.
Officer: ______.
Witness: No, I couldn't even see the color of their hair.

options.A: Did they seem to be in a hurry?
options.B: Was there anyone else around at that time?
options.C: Were you able to notice any distinguishing features?
options.D: How long did you stay at the scene after that?
options.E: Did you report this to anyone else before calling us?

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Şahidin 'saç rengini bile göremedim' cevabı, polisin 'ayırt edici özellik' (distinguishing features) sorusuna verilmiş bir yanıttır.

prompt:
Reporter: The public is concerned about the new tax policy.
Minister: We understand, but it is necessary for long-term stability.
Reporter: ______.
Minister: We have introduced subsidies to mitigate that impact.

options.A: The policy has been praised by many economic experts
options.B: Won't this disproportionately affect low-income families?
options.C: When will the new regulations come into effect?
options.D: The government is planning to reduce public spending
options.E: Is there any other way to ensure economic recovery?

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bakanın 'etkiyi azaltmak için sübvansiyon getirdik' cevabı, muhabirin 'dar gelirlileri etkiler mi' (affect low-income) endişesine yöneliktir.

prompt: The minister’s assurances sounded confident, but analysts found them unconvincing because they ignored key economic indicators.

options.A: Analysts were not persuaded by the minister's confident talk as he failed to consider important economic data.
options.B: The minister was not confident about the economic indicators, which analysts also pointed out in their report.
options.C: Important economic data were ignored by the minister despite the analysts' convincing arguments.
options.D: Confidence was lacking in the minister's assurances, so analysts rejected his economic report entirely.
options.E: Analysts found the minister's talk unconvincing even though he addressed every key economic indicator.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Orijinal cümledeki 'unconvincing' (persuaded - olumsuz) ve 'ignored key indicators' (failed to consider) yapıları A şıkkında korunmuştur.

prompt: Technological progress can improve living standards, yet it can also widen inequality if benefits are unevenly distributed.

options.A: Living standards only improve through technology when the benefits are shared equally among all people.
B) Technological advancement always leads to greater inequality regardless of how the benefits are shared.
C) Although technology may enhance how we live, it might also increase the gap between people if distributed unfairly.
D) Inequality is a natural result of technology, so living standards do not really improve for the majority.
E) Progress in technology is necessary to reduce inequality and improve the general living standards.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Yet' (although), 'widen inequality' (increase the gap) ve 'unevenly distributed' (unfairly distributed) eşleşmeleri C'yi doğru kılar.

prompt: The suspect is believed to have leaked confidential documents to a rival company long before the investigation began.

options.A: The investigation started because the suspect was caught leaking documents to a competitor.
options.B: It is thought that the suspect shared secret files with another firm well before the official probe started.
options.C: Documents were leaked to a rival company only after the investigation into the suspect had begun.
options.D: Before the investigation, the suspect was believed to be innocent of sharing secret information.
options.E: A rival company helped the suspect to leak confidential documents during the investigation.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is believed' (is thought), 'leaked' (shared), 'confidential' (secret) ve 'investigation' (probe) kelime değişimleri B'de başarılıdır.

prompt: The committee insisted on reviewing the raw data before approving the final report to ensure its accuracy.

options.A: To make sure the report was correct, the committee demanded to see the original data prior to giving their approval.
options.B: The final report was approved by the committee even though the raw data were found to be inaccurate.
options.C: Reviewing raw data is the only way for the committee to guarantee that every report is approved.
options.D: Accuracy was not a concern for the committee as long as the raw data were provided before the deadline.
options.E: The committee approved the report because the raw data had already been reviewed by experts.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Insisted on' (demanded), 'raw data' (original data) ve 'before' (prior to) yapıları A'da doğru verilmiştir.

prompt: In the world of finance, some risks are quantifiable and can be predicted with accuracy. ______. These unforeseen events often have the most significant impact on the market.

options.A: Mathematical models are used to calculate potential losses
options.B: Investors usually prefer stable and low-risk assets
options.C: However, others are completely unpredictable and catch experts by surprise
options.D: Therefore, most people choose to invest in well-known companies
options.E: The goal of every analyst is to eliminate risk entirely

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Boşluktan önceki 'bazı riskler öngörülebilir' ifadesine zıt olarak 'diğerleri öngörülemez' (unpredictable) ifadesi gelmelidir.

prompt: Ancient architecture often reflects the social hierarchy of the time. Temples and palaces were built to dwarf the common people, emphasizing the power of the elite. ______. Even today, these structures evoke a sense of awe and submission.

options.A: Building materials were usually sourced from local quarries
options.B: The use of scale and perspective was a deliberate psychological tool
options.C: Many commoners were employed as skilled laborers during construction
options.D: The preservation of these sites is a major challenge for modern governments
options.E: Archaeologists are still discovering new layers beneath these buildings

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Boşluk öncesindeki 'insanları küçük gösterme' (dwarf) çabası, 'psikolojik bir araç' (psychological tool) nitelemesiyle tamamlanır.

prompt: Digital literacy is no longer an optional skill in the modern workforce. Most professional roles require a high level of proficiency with various software and online platforms. ______. As a result, those who lack these skills face significant barriers to employment.

options.A: Social media is the primary way people communicate with their families
options.B: Traditional education systems are struggling to keep up with this demand
options.C: This shift has fundamentally changed how we perceive career stability
options.D: Furthermore, many companies now conduct their entire operations remotely
options.E: The cost of hardware has decreased significantly over the last decade

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Digital literacy' gerekliliğini destekleyen 'uzaktan operasyon' (remote operations) örneği akışı güçlendirir.

prompt: Scientific consensus is a slow and rigorous process. Findings must be replicated and peer-reviewed multiple times before they are widely accepted. ______. It ensures that only the most robust and verified ideas become part of the established body of knowledge.

options.A: This skepticism is not a weakness but a fundamental strength of science
options.B: Many researchers struggle to find funding for long-term projects
options.C: Popular science often misinterprets these findings for a general audience
options.D: The speed of publication has increased due to online journals
options.E: Individual genius is still the most important factor in discovery

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Boşluktan sonraki 'en sağlam fikirlerin kalmasını sağlar' ifadesi, bu sürecin bir 'güç' (strength) olduğunu söyleyen A şıkkıyla bağlanır.

prompt: (I) Solar energy is often touted as the ultimate solution to the energy crisis. (II) It is clean, inexhaustible, and increasingly cost-effective. (III) Most modern houses are now being built with better insulation to save energy. (IV) However, the storage of solar power remains a significant technical challenge. (V) Until batteries become more efficient, we cannot rely on it as our primary source.

options.A: I
options.B: II
options.C: III
options.D: IV
options.E: V

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metin 'Güneş enerjisi' üzerinedir. III. cümledeki 'ev yalıtımı' (insulation) konusu akışı bozmaktadır.

prompt: (I) The Renaissance was a period of immense cultural and artistic rebirth in Europe. (II) Artists began to use perspective and realism to depict the human form. (III) At the same time, the printing press revolutionized the spread of knowledge. (IV) Many artists in the period were funded by wealthy merchant families like the Medicis. (V) Modern art, on the other hand, often focuses on abstract concepts rather than realism.

options.A: I
options.B: II
options.C: III
options.D: IV
options.E: V

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metin Rönesans dönemini anlatırken, V. cümledeki 'Modern Sanat' karşılaştırması tarihsel akışı bozmaktadır.

prompt: (I) Remote work offers flexibility that many employees find highly attractive. (II) It eliminates the need for long commutes, saving both time and money. (III) Public transport systems in major cities are often overcrowded during rush hours. (IV) Yet, the lack of face-to-face interaction can lead to feelings of professional isolation. (V) Finding a balance between the two remains a challenge for modern managers.

options.A: I
options.B: II
options.C: III
options.D: IV
options.E: V

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metin 'Uzaktan Çalışma' avantaj/dezavantajları üzerinedir. III. cümledeki 'toplu taşıma kalabalığı' genel bir bilgi olup ana konudan sapmaktadır.

prompt: (I) Bees are essential for the survival of many ecosystems as primary pollinators. (II) Without them, the global food supply would be at serious risk. (III) Pesticides and habitat loss are the main reasons for their declining numbers. (IV) Some people are highly allergic to bee stings and must carry emergency medication. (V) Efforts are now being made to create more bee-friendly agricultural environments.

options.A: I
options.B: II
options.C: III
options.D: IV
options.E: V

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metin arıların ekolojik önemi ve korunması üzerinedir. IV. cümledeki 'arı alerjisi' tıbbi bir detay olup konu dışıdır.

prompt: (I) Ethical AI development requires transparency in how algorithms are designed. (II) Users should be informed about how their data is being used for training models. (III) The hardware required to run these models is becoming more expensive every year. (IV) Accountability is also crucial when AI systems make decisions that affect people's lives. (V) Therefore, developers must prioritize fairness over speed in their implementation.

options.A: I
options.B: II
options.C: III
options.D: IV
options.E: V

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Metin 'YZ Etiği' üzerinedir. III. cümledeki 'donanım maliyeti' (hardware cost) teknik/mali bir detay olup etik tartışmasının akışını bozar.
